* Rioting breaks out in [[Montreal]] after the [[Montreal Canadiens]] of the [[NHL]] win their [[2008 Stanley Cup Playoffs#(1) Montreal Canadiens vs. (8) Boston Bruins|first round playoff series]] against the [[Boston Bruins]]. Several police cars are torched, but there are no reports of any serious injuries. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/news/national/rioting-canadiens-fans-torch-police-cars/article18449266/ (Canadian Press via Globe and Mail)]
* A [[missile]] hits the headquarters of the [[Supreme Islamic Iraqi Council]] [[political party]] in [[Baghdad]].  No one is reported injured.  [https://www.reuters.com/article/middleeastCrisis/idUSL21630748 (Reuters)]
* A boat carrying [[Haiti]]an immigrants capsizes off the coast of [[the Bahamas]].  At least 20 deaths are reported by the [[United States Coast Guard]].  [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/americas/7359370.stm (BBC News)]
